'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=椋羽}} is a quest-exclusive NPC that first appears with '''[[Wenxi]]''' in {{Quest|The Wind Before the Storm}}. 
__NOTOC__
{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Anran:''' Excuse me, any word about my husband? He left the village yesterday morning...
:'''Wenxi:''' I'm sorry...
:<small>{{sic}} The idle dialogue is reversed</small> 

==Dialogue==
:'''Wenxi:''' Excuse me, any word about my husband? He left the village yesterday morning, but he still hasn't returned...

:'''Anran:''' I'm sorry, we haven't seen him either...

:'''Anran:''' But we'll let you know the moment there's news.

:'''Wenxi:''' Oh, my darling... Please be safe...
{{Dialogue End}}
